## Hypothesis
We hypothesize that tightening the stop loss (35% premium loss), taking profits later (75% premium gain), exiting early after 12 minutes, trading further OTM (strike_offset=2), and arming the profit lock later (60% gain) will improve the strategy by capturing larger moves while cutting losses quickly and avoiding prolonged exposure. This is based on the grinder output showing high wide_pnl and edge_capture (though edge_capture is below the OP-16 floor).

## Mechanism
Entry: Trigger when vol_ratio_threshold >= 1.2 and strike_offset=2 (2nd OTM put) is met (exact entry logic of the base strategy is unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to confirm).  
Exit:  
- Take profit at 75% premium gain (selling 2/3 of position at TP1, per standard scale-out rules).  
- Stop loss at 35% premium loss.  
- Time stop: exit after 12 minutes if not stopped out.  
- Profit lock: arms at 60% premium gain and trails 15% off the high-water mark (standard chandelier, but arm percentage changed from 5% to 60%).
